entries.cba8c88758163bd6: The company has formulated a three-year medium-term management plan, “TTC150 Stage３,” starting with the fiscal year ended December 2024, and is working toward the fiscal year ended December 2026, its final year. In milling, it is pursuing capital investment that creates products customers choose and improves productivity and quality; in food, speed-focused product development that captures customer needs; in pearled barley and feed, building a structure that makes use of the strengths of the four companies in the pearled barley and feed business under Torigoe Grain Holdings Co., Ltd., with a focus on raw materials and quality; corporate innovation using digital technology; and strengthening IR and shareholder returns.
